settings.keepWarm.subtitle: For Claude bots signed in with a subscription. Design from Cache Tax (MIT) by Karan Bansal.

settings.keepWarm.help: After a turn in a thread with at least 50k tokens of context, Touko sends one tool-less, forked request every 50 idle minutes so the next message re-reads the cache instead of re-writing the whole thread.
